reviews.title: A really good airline
reviews.text: I never write reviews but I had to make an exception for Thai Airlines. I have been on so many appalling airlines in the last year (EasyJet, Wizz etc..) who treat their customers with distain, but Thai Airways was fantastic. They departed on time for my flight to Bangkok, connecting flight to Bali, and my return flights home, and had the best service on board even though I was in economy. The crew were smartly dressed, the food on board was good and I enjoyed the online entertainment on the plane. Would without a shadow of a doubt fly Thai Airlines again.
reviews.author: warlord99

reviews.title: BKK-DPS-BKK : Aircraft requires to be upgraded
reviews.text: I flew from BKK-DPS-BKK, firstly there is only one flight per day. So by the time we reach DPS already half of the day is gone. The Thai service is very good, food and beverages are great, but the aircraft is tad old. The seats are not fully reclining and does not give a comfortable sleep even in business class. The other problem is the Inflight entertainment system. Its really old and non-responsive. The content available is also very very limited. I noticed that many people were getting there own media (in Ipad or phones) to entertain themselves.
reviews.author: Parit Gupta

reviews.title: Excellent customer service -lost property
reviews.text: After reading some of the previous reviews, I was a little concerned about flying with Thai airlines but everything was fine- the film choice was a bit limited but the service was friendly and efficient. However the main reason for this review is to thank the staff for all their help when I lost one of my ear pods during the flight. When the plane landed 4 of the cabin crew thoroughly searched the area where I had been sitting -they were incredibly helpful but couldn’t locate it. I reported the item missing to customer service the next day and they emailed straight back to say my ear pod had been found. They then arranged for it to be flown to a nearby airport for me to collect and emailed and phoned to ensure that I knew all the arrangements and had collected it ok -amazing customer service thank you!
reviews.author: jmc21332

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: We flew Thai Airways again. This time from Bangkok to Osaka by Business class. The check-in was smooth and we enjoy Thai Airways Lounge before departure. The plane was quite new and we enjoy very good service from cabin crew. The seat is quite good, larger than other Thai Airways Business class. We did have some good sleep before landing. The breakfast is quite good and tasty. The flight was smooth and we arrive a little before schedule. Overall we are very satisfied.
reviews.author: Rithee

reviews.title: Good service, nice staff and good food
reviews.text: Good service and reasonably priced airfares. I've flown with them a couple of times between Australia and India and have never faced any issues.
reviews.author: fred

reviews.title: Comfortable flight from Manila to Bangkok!
reviews.text: I have no complaints with this flight other than a 30-minute delayed departure. Check-in was also delayed by a system shut-down in Manila, but the staff were attentive and sympathetic. Boarding was smooth and the plane (787 Dreamliner) was very comfortable. Movie selection was good. Service was prompt and attentive. And the food (I opted for prawns and potatoes) was surprisingly good.
reviews.author: Raintree_Thailand

reviews.title: First Thai flight in more than three years!
reviews.text: After decades of flying Thai, I had a COVID-induced hiatus of more than three years. Glad to see that Thai has so far survived and is trying to re-invent itself as a profitable airline. The service to Manila was typically elegant and professionally staffed and well managed. Food was rather disappointing, but otherwise the flight was OK.
reviews.author: Raintree_Thailand

reviews.title: Poor service on board
reviews.text: We boarded at 2125 and then had our first meal by 2200, which was the good part . 2300 lights out and no service for seven hours . No offer of water even though their on board video says to stay hydrated . Turns out if you can find someone they will give you water . Just thought it was because it was an overnight flight ….but no . Same coming back . 1250 flight , food served within 40 minutes , then nothing for seven hours ! Again you have to go and ask for water etc . Lights out the whole flight . Used to be staff would walk up the aisle every hour offering drinks but no more . Really poor . And actually they got continually pestered by passengers for snacks after four hours ,and drinks so they might as well have offered drinks from the trolley like they used to.
reviews.author: Milesandmiles1

reviews.title: Affordable
reviews.text: We had a bit of a wait for check in. For some reason only 1 of the business class check ins were taking business class passengers. The others were taking economy passengers. After about 15 minutes they seemed to realise the business class line wasn’t moving and started checking in passengers. Flights were on time. In fact due to tail wind we arrived an hour early into Bangkok. Service was good. I had ordered vegetarian. The entree was beautiful but the main of noodles was a bit soggy. Entertainment system isn’t great, not a lot of choice in films or tv series. I was surprised that they only offer one series for each tv series. Given my flight was overnight not a huge issue. First time flying business class with Thai. Well set up with seat and ability to lie down flat. Price wise very reasonable for business class experience.
reviews.author: catmac5373

reviews.title: Very helpfull
reviews.text: I was stuck for 2,5 hours in traffic, so got there 30 min before departure. I called before arriving. They let me take the baggage with me since it was too late to check in. Their service was amazing.
reviews.author: Kunde

reviews.title: Baggage lost! Non existent customer service to assist
reviews.text: I travelled from Melbourne to Hyderabad on 1 June via Bangkok. Only one of my 2 bags was returned. My 25 kg heavier bag which had all my clothes, didn’t make it. It has been really hard to get in touch with anyone from Thai Airways. All the Indian contact numbers for Thai Airways are mostly uncontactable as they are invalid. I even dropped in to their Hyderabad office only to be told that if I drop my email I will be posted with updates. So far no one has contacted me. I have also submitted a claim online for some financial reimbursement as I have to buy new clothes till I get my bag. I haven’t received any email confirmation whether a form was submitted or someone is processing my request. I have even tried to contact Thai Airways Bangkok office but could only get through once where I was told that I should contact Hyderabad airport. Hyderabad airport has been following up and haven’t received any feedback. The whole problem started as someone else’s tag was applied to my bag as a result it only made it to Bangkok and not further. While I can understand that mixups can happen, the complete lack of customer service is very appalling. Thai Airways has been the airline of choice for all these years but my latest experience has made me think about flying with Thai Airways in the future. It’s so far been a nightmare.
reviews.author: shubhankar t

reviews.title: Good Airlines
reviews.text: I purchased the two ticket online and they were offering a discounted rate for a round trip last year. The ground service was good in Dhaka. Good food and entertainment inflight. Crews were good as well.
reviews.author: Dr. Ziauddin Ahmed

reviews.title: Service with a smile
reviews.text: I have been travelling with Thai Airways for over 10 years now. I really like the airlines, its service, its fleet and also its food. I feel a little improvement can be in terms of Entertainment options. I love flying Thai airways
reviews.author: Parit Gupta

reviews.title: Always delay
reviews.text: My first flight to Bangkok was delayed for 45 minutes for no reason. My return flight to HK was delayed for 1h before boarding. After we board on the plane, there seemed to have some problems with the plane (weather was very good), we had been sitting ON THE PLANE for another 2 hours without any explanation. Overall, the plane was delayed for 3h+ without any explanation. Poor airplane quality and poor service as well. I would suggest you choose other airline if you don't want to have delayed flights. (100% delay).
reviews.author: Jess C

reviews.title: Service is outstanding and caring
reviews.text: We travelled from Australia to London Heathrow with Thai airways and are now on our way home. At all times the Thai service was extremely caring and thoughtful. The Flight attendants are impeccably dressed. The food served was excellent. The only negative was the poor choice of movies.
reviews.author: Kate R

reviews.title: Overrated - very poor experience in business
reviews.text: I've been flying back from Melbourne to Frankfurt via Bangkok. 2 Business class flights and same poor experience: very old planes, poor service (flight attendants barely spoke english and create weird situations in interaction with passengers, they smile alot but are neither friendly nor helpful. ) food quality below average for business class (corresponded rather to an economy meal in real high end airlines - especially main dishes were really poor), little choice of wines, outdated entertainment with very limited choice (especially when you are flying in the same day 10 + 13 hours flights)... furthermore at Bangkok airport I've visited 2 lounges and one was extremely old with disgustingly dirty showers. Newer lounge was ok though. It was the first time I was flying Thai airways and based on this disappointing experience I think this airline is truly overrated. Thai airways was perhaps good 2 decades ago but old airplanes/equipment and lack of appropriate service make it in my opinion an under-average option. I will probably avoid it in the future especially for long trips.
reviews.author: touriste_chine

reviews.title: Business Class Singas to Bangkok
reviews.text: What an old fleet stil at Thai Airwaysl. Thank goodness for Kris Business lounge at Changi, Service was good, food good.
reviews.author: Robert B

reviews.title: Unrepresentative of the Amazing Thai Service and Standards
reviews.text: This airline is just simply shoddy. We pre-ordered vegetarian meals and when we got on the flight were told nothing was booked. We were given meat meals and told to ‘pick the meat out of it’. When we complained they got very offended that we didn’t understand their point of view that they ‘didn’t have it logged’. Bizarre! We kept getting dirty looks off the steward the entire flight and continued to be offered meat options. We didn’t eat anything on an 11 hour flight. Not a great start to our honeymoon. Fortunately, we have experienced nothing but amazing service from almost all services in Thailand and its strange how Thai airlines can fall so far short of their fellow countrymen. After the flight we first tried to confirm the vegetarian meals for the flight home and firstly the app said it was confirmed but reset itself. We called customer service who said it hadn’t been logged but confirmed they had done it. Only to later receive a response from customer services in regard to our complaint who said they noticed we hadn’t logged the meals for the return journey so had done it. It seems to just keep resetting itself and they don’t seem to get that. So frustrating and we have no confidence that we will get the meals on the way home. No form of compensation was offered at all. Nothing. Such incredibly poor service and so disappointed.
reviews.author: richardwD1374IS

reviews.title: Pleasant Experience
reviews.text: Our party of 7 recently flew with Thai Airways to Bangkok. Due to scheduling conflicts, we had to reschedule our flight a couple of times and each time, the customer service representative was very accommodating and prompt in assisting us in our requests. On our return, we accidentally left a bag on the plane. I emailed the airline the next morning and they were quick to respond and found my bag within a few hours on the same day. The crew we travelled with were all very friendly and approachable. Overall, we had a pleasant experience and would definitely fly with them again.
reviews.author: Jaclyn

reviews.title: Horrible Customer Service
reviews.text: Very poor response on refund of the ticket. We have been waiting for 5 months and they are saying it will take 6 months. Why it takes 6 months ? Totally unacceptable.
reviews.author: Sal Ak

reviews.title: Really good experience
reviews.text: Really good experience with Thai air. All of the staff were so lovely and helpful, went above and beyond to help me and my wife. The flights were about 12 hours, and we were given two main meals, a snack and regular drinks and water throughout. We are vegan and we were able to get vegetarian Jain meals which were fresh and absolutely delicious, they checked before the flight we were vegan and were given separate meals to the regular service, all very good health meals. The in-flight entertainment was good, nice selection of films and TV. Given pillows and blankets and the flight itself was comfortable. The way to Bangkok was lovely, but I think the way home was a slightly older model of plane so the seats were a bit more uncomfortable with less legroom but still very good nonetheless. I would happily use them again, big thanks to all the staff and crew. No delays with check-in, all very organised and on-time. All the negative reviews are regarding people who had a flight cancelled and have been reimbursed via vouchers, which it clearly says when you buy tickets so this isn't really a shock
reviews.author: HJ1

reviews.title: Dishonest company
reviews.text: Dishonest company that does not reimburse the luggage it has damaged despite the strict observance of the procedure. Do not answer emails or phone calls. This company is completely adrift, it is a shadow of its former self. Travel on board a 777 totally tired and faded. Lousy performances and limited service. I hope that the non visible and security aspects are well respected. I am still waiting for the reimbursement of my luggage, which is considered unusable and irreparable by the CDG airport service.
reviews.author: Christophe G

reviews.title: Nothing less than scammers
reviews.text: I cannot retain to express my complete dissatisfaction and outrage at the disgraceful behavior of Thai Airways in relation to my refund request for a flight ticket booked in 2019. It is utterly unacceptable that a supposedly reputable airline is resorting to devious tactics to avoid paying their rightful debts. I have provided all the necessary documentation and information, as requested by Thai Airways in the past. However, the airline continues to delay the refund process, asking for the same information repeatedly, wasting my time and causing me great inconvenience. It is incredibly disappointing to see that Thai Airways, a national flag carrier of such a prestigious country as Thailand, is engaging in such unscrupulous behavior. This is nothing short of scamming, and it is unacceptable for any company, let alone an airline with a reputation to uphold. I must inform you that I will make sure that this disgraceful behavior is brought to the attention of the media, as well as other potential customers who may be considering flying with your airline.
reviews.author: Francesco P

reviews.title: Rude staffs!
reviews.text: Thai airways lounge at concourse D, level 3 (main entrance opposite gate D4) Two lady staffs at check in counter 21/04/2023 16:00 I gave passport to them, but i put the previous boarding pass (Hongkong flight) to them as well because not sure whether do they need to check it or not.. then they using terrible words with unkind tone to us. She said “why am i still keep this unwanted boarding pass in here” It make her complicated to check those transfer flights number and name. I still remember untill now “จะเก็บไวเพื่อ” & ทำเสียงลำคาน “madamm I already scan it for youuuu” Which is I understand ALL what she was talking. I didn’t response with this lady. And try to be calm. ❗️NOT RECOMMENDED THAI airways to anyone as I used to do.
reviews.author: Nana

reviews.title: Very disappointing company
reviews.text: Very disappointing company Dirty and old airplane Kindness of the staff on board disappeared Very expensive ticket price
reviews.author: TOM B

reviews.title: Cancelled our flight and tried to refund us with vouchers
reviews.text: They cancelled our flight and they won't refund us cash. We did a chat and they told us they would refund us cash, they didn't. Gave us vouchers. We have called twice, got hung up on twice after an hour hold. We have tried chat twice which just doesn't work. I advise you don't use this airline, the customer service is terrible.
reviews.author: Rin

reviews.title: Good airline
reviews.text: I purchased the ticket online and they were offering a discounted rate for a round trip last year. The ground service was good but check-in process was slow. Good food and entertainment inflight. Crews were good as well.
reviews.author: Dr. Ziauddin Ahmed

reviews.title: Worst Customer Service Experience
reviews.text: The worst customer service ever experienced in our international travel history. It has been 4 months since we have reported and requested damaged luggage claim, but this filthy airlines niether cares to respond nor replies to several emails for settlement. It is shocking and utterly disappointing that such a so called reputed airlines can be immensely rude in conduct to not even bother to reply on e-mails leave alone making good for the loss incurred for their fault and mis-management. PNR - 5K6RFF Origin- Sydney, Australia Transit - Bangkok, Thailand Destination- Mumbai, India Flight Nos- TG476 and TG317 Departure Date & Time from Sydney- 14th January, 2023 - 1000 Hours (ACT) Arrival Date & Time at Mumbai- 15th January, 2023 - 2200 Hours (IST) No. of passengers - 4 We had checked in our baggage with tag number - TG 424098 at Sydney along with other bags. However, when we received the said baggage at Mumbai airport on the belt, we found that the baggage was broken with irreparable damage. Soon upon receiving the damaged luggage, we immediately reported the concern to Thai Airways staff member, Ms. Simran who was present there on duty. While, we requested to personally meet a Senior staff member to present the issue, Ms. Simran responded that there was no need to meet anyone since she had already inspected, acknowledged and certified the loss. Attaching herewith a photo of her acknowledgement and inspection receipt. The bag is otherwise new and now the utility of the bag is no more, making it scrap. We expect the loss to be made good by Thai Airways.
reviews.author: Amrit Thakkar

reviews.title: Good airline and flight
reviews.text: I am a frequent flyer and I was apprehensive to fly with Thai Airways given the recent reviews. However I am happy to report a good experience and everything went very smoothly. The staff on board were welcoming and attentive and the food and drinks sufficient for the 11 hour flight. The IFE had a good selection of films for adults and children. Both flights were on time and there no issues with my luggage.
reviews.author: Paul

reviews.title: Worst airlines!
reviews.text: I took a 9-hour flight from Sydney to Bangkok on March 11, 2023. I specifically purchased a seat with extra legroom as I was traveling with an infant and needed a bassinet. My partner sat behind me. I was informed that I would not be provided a bassinet even though my child met the size requirements because they were 8 months old and not 6 months old. I was stuck in my seat with my baby and unable to even eat. The flight attendant was very rude and told us that if my partner wanted to sit in the empty seat next to me, he would have to pay $120 AUD for a paid seat. I would not have even purchased this seat if I knew I would not be provided a bassinet. As an alternative, the flight attendant offered us worse seats in the back rows, where my partner would also be seated separately. I had an inflatable bed for the baby, which the flight attendant also did not allow me to use. My child had to sit for 9 hours despite not even being able to sit yet and now has a distorted silhouette. I regret purchasing another premium economy flight with this airline before this experience, as it was the worst flight and airline experience of my life, and I will be pursuing legal action. Avoid this airline at all costs!
reviews.author: Kamila Ł

reviews.title: Waiting for my refund for ages
reviews.text: I have been waiting for my refund for the last 1.5 year. Not happy with their customer care service. My booking reference number is 6OM3OR
reviews.author: RSB

reviews.title: Ticketing Issues, Rude Ground Staff & Unresponsive Customer Service
reviews.text: I read the review by another Tripadvisor user, sidhuroop098, and second her vote of disappointment. These are accounts of the 5 issues I have encountered recently:- The first issue was rudeness of one of the Thai Airways ground staff at Changi Airport Terminal 1. I e-booked a flight TG410 online on 31 Dec 2022 at the Thai airways website. But when I went to the airport on 8 Mar 2023 - the day of my flight - showing the printouts of both the Thai airways confirmation email with a valid Reservation Code and the e-Booking confirmation, the officer challenged their legitimacy and rudely asked me which website I booked it from. This was in spite of the fact that I showed her the printed email with the Subject: Confirmation for reservation, Singapore, 8 March from "Thai Airways reservation confirmation" no-reply thaiairways email address. Even when faced with my extreme anxiety, she acted as if I was totally at fault, refused to help and scolded me for failing to remember which website had I purchased the ticket from. The second issue was the failure of either the ticketing search & retrieval system, or the ground staff's ability to use it. I had booked my flights from the Thai Airways website itself, yet despite all the documentary proof I produced, the ground staff were unable to locate my flight record, hence I had to request for her manager. Even then, he wasn't able to locate it, and it was only when he contacted to his colleagues in Thailand, that my ticketing records were found. The third issue was systemic failure in the airline ticketing and notification system. Although my payment apparently didn't get through (as the staff eventually found out) and I wasn't charged, both the email and the Booking Confirmation indicated that Payment has been made. Since the amount hadn't deducted, then Thai airways shouldn't have generated the Booking Confirmation, and it should also have notified me of the ticketing failure, but didn't. The fourth issue was total unresponsiveness of the airlines. Due to the error, I lost a day's leave taken from work, ~sgd708 due to booking a urgent replacement flight the next day, and the connecting airline's penalty fee of ~sgd133 for last minute flight changes. I raised a complaint on Thai airways website contact_us feedback form page, but did not receive any response even after a month. I even raised a response using the Thai airways Facebook Messenger bot, but this too didn't elicit a response. I then emailed Thai airways contact service and the Singapore General Manager hoping that the airline could explain to give an opportunity to do restore my confidence. Yet I still have not received any response even after two weeks. The fifth issue was airline inflexibility and lack of customer empathy. As the flight still had empty seats, I requested to purchase our tickets since our ticketing had apparently failed. However, this was rejected on the grounds of airline policy despite my pleas, and no options were offered. I don't have issue with the airplane, the flight attendants, the food, etc. Once anyone boards on the flight, I reckon that basically everything would be fine. I would even like to commend the manager of that rude staff for his handling of the case and would like to acknowledge his best efforts to help us. I also acknowledge that prior to this, I had travelled with Thai Airways 5 times since 2001 and those experiences had been great. This time, it was specifically these pre-flight logistic issues and the low empathy of the ground staff which had marred my experience. I should also highlight that unfortunately the above account was not an isolated case. Separately, in late Dec 2022, I tried to use the Thai Travel Voucher under the Promotion Code at the Thai Airways website, but failed to do so. I emailed Thai airways contact service more than 3 months ago on 31 Dec 2022, but still have not received any response to that email. I have already gone past my huge disappointment and anger, and it is
reviews.author: fivewaves6711

reviews.title: Terrible customer service for the disabled!
reviews.text: The service was appalling. The same person who checked my family in at the check-in counter came back at boarding to say that the battery of the battery operated wheelchair wasn't allowed, and that we had to go all the way back to cargo to deposit the battery or that we would have to leave in at 'lost and found'. There was an overall dismissive attitude and this could have been prevented at check-in if this was accounted for. Eventually had to leave the battery behind incapacitating the passenger, causing significant mental anguish and continuing to do so in Melbourne - wondering whether a suit can be filed.
reviews.author: Abhilash B

reviews.title: Great on the way but a pain in the back coming home.
reviews.text: I would just like to say that I had a great flight from Sydney Australia to Bangkok Thailand and then a connecting flight to Krabi with an excellent holiday BUT, after leaving Krabi at 8:30pm and landing at Bangkok at around 10:20pm, I had to wait until 8:30am for my connecting flight to Sydney. This was fine until I boarded my flight to find that someone had taken my seat to which this was quickly rectified. I proceeded to place my carry on luggage into the overhead compartment only to find that the person in the seat behind me had filled the space. I politely asked the person if he could make some room but he ignored me. The person seated next to me got out of his seat and organised the bags so I sat and waited for the take off. The male with his wife and 2 year old child behind were not very helpful and their child was screaming and crying very loudly with no help from the cabin crew. This continued throughout the flight with the child kicking my seat and not letting me rest. I asked the father of the child if he could please stop the girl from kicking my seat but he just ignored me so I asked the cabin crew to help and they spoke with the person who just ignored them also. I was not happy with the flight or the cabin crews response or help with this situation and I hope that this experience is not repeated.
reviews.author: 8396steve

reviews.title: Impossible to book flights
reviews.text: How the hell do you do business with this company? I went online to get quotes for a multi city fare, but they will only give quotes for economy, not premium economy or business class. So… I decided to download the app. Their app will only give quotes for return fares not multicity!!! Do they realise how much business they are losing by making getting quotes so difficult! I give up and will do my business with an alternative airline
reviews.author: 123jonty

reviews.title: Great flight
reviews.text: Flew across the globe from Bangkok to London and they really looked after us, drinks, food, blankets anything you need I wouldn't fly with anyone else
reviews.author: Aidan W

reviews.title: Cheap for a reason
reviews.text: I fly budget airlines in Europe all the time so know what to expect and thought Thailand would be similar but was dissapointed with Thai Airways. Check in on the App was difficult, kept crashing but eventually managed it. Bag drop at Bangkok was very slow. Came to boarding the flight and it was a free for all, the gate staff didn't seem to have any control. Seating very cramped on the plane, made Ryanair seat spacing look big. Arriving at Phuket pilot parked us on Gate 8 but should of been Gate 7 so after waiting for about 15 minutes it was decided to call a tug and move the plane to the correct gate so ended up being delayed by 35 minutes.
reviews.author: billandbens

reviews.title: i flew with thaiairways on 02.04.23 from BKK to FRA. During the whole flight it was very
reviews.text: very bad experience. it was during the whole flight very cold on board. i put my winter jacket on and the blanket same every passenger. now i am sick and have a fever. thaiairways pays the doctor for me? i complained many to the airhostess but nothing changed. We had to wait 2 hours after take off for our food and something to drink. Horrible flight!!!!!! Rochus Mueller
reviews.author: Rochus M

reviews.title: Refund for cancellation
reviews.text: Still waiting over 6 months for a refund of cancelable tickets. Don't answer their phones or emails. Have gone through my credit card company to try get money refunded. Absolutely disgraceful customer service.
reviews.author: JMC

reviews.title: LHR-BKK - Way better than expected given the reviews!
reviews.text: I was worried about flying with Thai Airways given the pretty terrible reviews on Trip Advisor, but we just got home from Thailand having travelled from London to Bangkok, and a roundtrip to Koh Samui (operated by Bangkok Airways) and had a fantastic experience. I should preface this with the fact that I've seen from other reviews that there's not really any way to contact Thai Airways from the UK, so if you have any issues or need to amend your booking, I think you're pretty stuck. This does put me off travelling with them in the future, as I really think you need that flexibility when spending so much money, but doesn't detract from the fantastic experience we just had with them. - Planes were good, LHR-BKK was brand new, a little older on the way back. Good legroom, we upgraded to bulk head for the return flight - worth it for £80 given it's 13hrs. -Entertainment was fine - a few new films, and some older, probably 50 in total.. but I always download my own so didn't use. - Meals were much better than other airlines - 2 big main meals and a snack on both journeys. Wine, soft drinks and the alcohol available - Asian and Western options - curry, pasta etc. - All flights on time, we had a connecting flight between Koh Samui and Bangkok and they arranged our luggage getting to the plane from our Bangkok Airways flight (which was also a great short haul flight and recommend highly). - Staff were very good on-board, in airport, we went to the transfer desk in BKK airport and paid for bulk head, was effortless and the woman at the desk was helpful and friendly. -Suitcases arrived safely and quickly at all airports Overall, if you've booked and worried (like I was) after seeing lots of negative reviews... don't be, it's as good as any other airline I have flown long haul with recently (BA, Virgin, United), but the real issue is the lack of contact and customer service if you need to get hold of them for any reason.
reviews.author: Sophie W

reviews.title: Super staff at ticketing office  Phuket
reviews.text: Big 'thank you' to the ticketing staff at Phuket airport as well as the employees at registration and baggage handling ! We made a mistake on our departure date (though I must say that the ticket information was quite confusing !) and all these wonderful people (some we never saw !) did their best to find and execute every step for another flight for us. We paid another ticket but we saved the hassle of 'stranded passengers'. Thai Airways should better warn their passengers when they buy their ticket though
reviews.author: Pat P

reviews.title: Total Harassment and very unprofessional  bahaviour by Thai Airways crew
reviews.text: We all passengers are recently Harassed by the Airport staff of Thai airways as they didn’t inform that its cancelled they were just updating time but when we checked online it was already cancelled and then they took 5 and a half hours to do something. The people were travelling with kids and some were elderly ,they didn’t provide us proper seating too.Not only this, when passengers tried to ask them or talk to them they were very rude and some random staff member from thai airways she was so much rude to an elder man and she was misbehaving . The kids were crying for milk and all. We had to go through the whole procedure of arrival cancellations stamps ,immigration clear and all. Then they took us to hotel and next morning hotel staff forced us to do check out, on the other hand airport staff told us not to check out before they inform us but hotel manager said airport staff told them to do check out for all the people. We got shifted to airport again it was 50 minutes away from airport. We waited at baggage counter for. almost 1 and a half hour there was no person on the counter then they came they had their tea and started baggage drop . We went to our gate number after doing whole procedure we did a day before . Then suddenly they changed our gate number.Then flight was cancelled once and then second time and we are still waiting last flight timing was 7.30 , which was cancelled and they are saying we dont know we have no information. This is very much disappointing for us and shame for this Thai Airways airline. We are buying food but some people have not enough money
reviews.author: Rupinder kaur

reviews.title: Unrivalled Comfort and the Best Food
reviews.text: Highly recommend this airline!! They have by far the best food I have experienced on any flight, extremely comfortable seats, and a beautiful staff that will always greet you with a smile. My favourite airline in Asia!!
reviews.author: Keegan

reviews.title: Please arrive in 21rst century
reviews.text: It's was my first flight ever, where we had to a) preorder vegetarian food and b) pay extra for it. Wow. Would've been alright if the stuff had just been eadable. But it was not. I have never had anything disgusting like this offered by catering in any airways. Longterm flight 12 hours. And exactly the same!! Meal in the morning as breakfast. The young attendant was just unprofessionally ignoring and arrogant to our meanwhile nearly desperate wish for something to eat. We then got a meal with sausage, where we put out the sausage. At least not hungry anymore. I don't know how this airways could earn like any prize for catering and service. The funny thing is, it would've been so easy... Just thai food.. A vegetarian coconut curry with rice.. What the heck? And of course this might never be an extra option to preorder. We are living in the 21rst century and consuming meat should really be not that unconscious at all. Speaking of a Buddhist country on top. And: take care of check-in luggage! The weight allowed for your international flight (30 kg said) may differ hugely from the weight allowed flying in country and back home (20 kg) and Thai air/Bangkok Air obviously don't cooperate (or they do well ;)) and charge every kg extra. 0No information on the tickets. If you had weight like allowed you could've left half of your things in the bin.
reviews.author: Caya

reviews.title: No staff to help
reviews.text: Was given wrong time of flight, arrived at airport and flight had already left. Had confirmed itinerary from Thai. Told me next flight to Syd sy in 5 days. Told me to gather receipts from five days and they may consider paying upon my return. What is going on at this airline. Ben back two weeks and get no one from Customer Service to talk to me.......always told they will call me but no one does.....no staff....no chance of service.....a once great airline just doesn’t care.....
reviews.author: dgvictor

reviews.title: Refundable ticket, yet they wont refund
reviews.text: I booked a return journey from heathrow to bangkok. The ticket was a refundable ticket.....I had to cancel due to having to care for a sick relative at home. Thai airways have ignored my emails for a month and after a reply eventualy stating i will recieve a refund in 4 to 6 weeks three months later I am still waiting and when I send email they have gone back to ignoring me. Next i will contact Star Alliance to see if any joy...if not then its the legal route through the courts to get the money MY money back. I would sugest that anyone flying to Thailand think carefully before flying to Thailand with Thai Airways
reviews.author: 693pip

reviews.title: Very dissapointed
reviews.text: Looking forward to our holiday, since 2020 , but oh dear we have been lucky enough to fly with many international carriers but this was without doubt the worst. Forget online check in and boarding passes, no desks for them No luggage drop off. 4 lanes for economy ,2 for royal silk , approx 25 passengers royal silk 1 economy not working 1 took over by flight supervisor, which meant 300 plus passengers through 2 lanes, , When we finally boarded over 1 hr late the plane looked really tired and well worn , Return journey better experience at airport online good luggage drop off good Plane as bad as journey out, nackered and wore out. never again.
reviews.author: Chris Beardall

reviews.text: After the Covid crisis = No more A 380 planes = No more, it's a shame - This company has become a Low Cost standard company with high-end company prices Price too high
reviews.author: LEA DUNYLLE

reviews.title: Terrible!!!
reviews.text: Boarded plane at Heathrow which was taken out of service due to a fault. 6/7 hours after we were taken off the plane we were told the flight was cancelled & we wouldn't be leaving until the next day. Despite trying to contact Thai airways a number of times to try and claim compensation for losses we incurred they have not bothered to reply. There were 10 of us in our party and we lost the money we paid for the hotel as well as time we should have spent in Thailand. Communication on the day the flight was cancelled and in Bangkok was appalling and virtually none existent! Plane was very old and the only positive I can say about Thai airways is the cabin crew were lovely.
reviews.author: Kirstie K

reviews.title: Delayed flight and awful customer service
reviews.text: My flight from November 2022 was delayed over 14 hours but cannot contact customer service for love nor money . My original journey was meant to be 23 hours to Sydney with a layover at Thailand, we were delayed 4 hours at Heathrow and spent the 4 hours on the stationary plane because they had already taxied. Because of these first delays I missed my transfer and was sent via Singapore, which included a total of a 10 hour wait in Bangkok and Singapore. When trying to claim compensation I have been directed to numerous customer service emails and only given a Thai contact number. I would strongly advise not to book Thai in case something goes wrong because it will not be resolved or compensated.
reviews.author: Alice D
